# ACorWeld — Maciej Kochel

> Independent, third-party welding and coating inspector combining IWE (International Welding Engineer) and FROSIO Level III qualifications. Client-side inspection, NDT, and quality systems for offshore wind, energy, automotive, waste-to-energy, and heavy industry projects across Europe, with a particular interest in Nordic markets.

## Who this is
Maciej Kochel is a welding and coating inspector based in Poland, working project-based across Europe. He holds IWE (International Welding Engineer), FROSIO Coating Inspector Level III, and NDT Level 2 (VT2, PT2, RT2/RT-F2) qualifications — an uncommon combination that lets one person inspect both structural welds and corrosion protection on the same project, rather than splitting the work across two specialists.

## Credentials
- FROSIO Certified Surface Treatment Inspector, Level III
- International Welding Engineer (IWE)
- NDT Level 2 (VT2, PT2, RT2 / RT-F2, EN ISO 9712)
- CQI/IRCA ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor

## Current role
Client-side Primary Steel Welding Engineer on East Anglia TWO, a North Sea offshore wind farm (ScottishPower Renewables / Iberdrola), since December 2025.

## Services
Welding inspection and supervision; coating and corrosion-protection inspection; non-destructive testing (NDT); client/third-party inspection; quality systems development and audit (ISO 3834, EN 1090, EN 15085); technical training for welding teams.

## Industries served
Offshore wind, energy and petrochemical, waste-to-energy, automotive and industrial construction, rail and heavy fabrication.
